dishes.name: Harvest Tide Tartine
dishes.tagline: Autumn's sweetest confection meets the oily honesty of the Atlantic.
recipe: 2 thick slices of rye bread, toasted
1 tin sardines in olive oil, drained
Flaky salt and cracked black pepper
steps: Toast the rye until deeply golden and let it cool for one minute, so the sour cream does not weep.
Spread each slice edge to edge with sour cream and season with lemon zest and pepper.
Lay the sardines on top in a neat, slightly overlapping fan, tails pointing outward.
Scatter the candy corn between the fish like fallen leaves, pressing each kernel gently into the cream.
Finish with dill and flaky salt, and serve at once, before anyone can object.
dishes.chef_note: Serve on a slate board with a glass of cold seltzer. The candy corn should be placed, never dropped.
dishes.photo_prompt: Two slices of toasted dark rye bread on a slate board, spread thickly with white sour cream, topped with a fan of silvery whole sardines and scattered bright orange-yellow-white candy corn kernels, dill sprigs, flaky salt, lemon wedge, rustic linen napkin, 45-degree angle

dishes.name: Nordic Carnival Crudo
dishes.tagline: The fairground and the fjord, finally on speaking terms.
steps: Chill four small plates in the freezer for ten minutes.
Lift the herring from its sauce and arrange three pieces on each plate, spooning a little of the cream beside them.
Crumble the blue cheese over the fish and scatter with red onion and chives.
Tear the cotton candy into fist-sized clouds and set one on each plate at the very last moment, before the cream begins to dissolve it.
Serve immediately with crispbread, and do not explain.
dishes.chef_note: The cotton candy will collapse into pink syrup within ninety seconds. This is not a flaw; it is the second course.
dishes.photo_prompt: Elegant white plate with pieces of pickled herring in creamy white sauce, crumbled blue cheese with blue veins, thin red onion rings, chives, and a large fluffy cloud of pink cotton candy perched on top, rye crispbread on the side, overhead shot, pale Scandinavian wood table

dishes.name: Salt-Cured Anchovy & Candy Corn Brittle
dishes.tagline: A Halloween classic, deepened with the brine of the Cantabrian coast.
recipe: 8 anchovy fillets in oil, drained and chopped
steps: Line a tray with baking paper.
Melt the sugar with the water and cook without stirring until a deep amber caramel forms.
Off the heat, whisk in the butter and baking soda; it will foam dramatically.
Fold in the candy corn and chopped anchovies quickly and pour onto the tray, spreading thin.
Sprinkle with flaky salt, cool completely, and break into jagged shards.
dishes.chef_note: Store in an airtight tin, away from anything you love. Pairs, improbably, with black coffee.
dishes.photo_prompt: Shards of glossy amber caramel brittle studded with orange yellow and white candy corn and small pieces of brown anchovy fillet, broken on parchment paper, a few whole anchovy fillets and loose candy corn beside it, dark moody background, close-up

dishes.name: Gefilte Fish in Chocolate Mole
dishes.tagline: Bubbie's Shabbos starter, reimagined by someone who never met her.
steps: Warm the chocolate syrup gently with cinnamon and chili until it smells like a Oaxacan market.
Let the sauce cool to room temperature; hot mole will melt the jelly.
Pool two tablespoons of sauce in the center of each plate.
Set a slice of gefilte fish in the center and crown it with its carrot coin.
Scatter with sesame seeds and coriander and serve chilled.
dishes.chef_note: Horseradish is optional. Courage is not.
dishes.photo_prompt: A pale oval slice of gefilte fish topped with an orange carrot coin, sitting in a glossy pool of dark chocolate sauce on a white plate, sprinkled with sesame seeds and coriander leaves, elegant fine dining plating, 45-degree angle

dishes.name: Mocha Egg Salad Brioche
dishes.tagline: Breakfast, dessert and your morning coffee, in one efficient bite.
recipe: 2 tbsp chocolate syrup, plus more to drizzle
1 tsp instant coffee granules, plus a pinch to finish
steps: Stir the chocolate syrup and coffee granules into the egg salad until it turns the color of a café au lait.
Toast the brioche cut-side down until golden.
Lay lettuce on the bottom buns and pile the mocha egg salad high.
Drizzle with more chocolate syrup and dust with a few unmelted coffee granules for crunch.
Close the buns and serve with a knife through the middle.
dishes.chef_note: Best eaten standing up, in case you need to leave quickly.
dishes.photo_prompt: Two golden toasted brioche buns filled with a tall mound of light brown egg salad, drizzled with dark chocolate syrup and sprinkled with coffee granules, lettuce leaves peeking out, on a café table with a cup of coffee, bright morning light

dishes.name: Umami Jelly Bean Salsa
dishes.tagline: A salsa for people who find tomatoes too predictable.
steps: Whisk the miso, rice vinegar and sesame oil into a smooth dressing.
Halve every jelly bean with a sharp, wet knife.
Toss the jelly beans with the onion and jalapeño.
Fold through the miso dressing and let it sit ten minutes, until the beans begin to sweat.
Serve in a stone molcajete with chips.
dishes.chef_note: Black licorice jelly beans are not optional. They are the point.
dishes.photo_prompt: Stone molcajete bowl filled with a colorful salsa of halved rainbow jelly beans, diced white onion and green jalapeño glistening with miso dressing, tortilla chips around it, on a rustic wooden table, overhead shot, vibrant colors

dishes.name: Strawberry Gefilte Parfait
dishes.tagline: Layered with care, like a family secret nobody asked to inherit.
steps: Cube the gefilte fish into neat 1 cm dice.
Spoon a layer of strawberry yogurt into two tall glasses.
Add a layer of fish, then a layer of corn, and repeat until the glasses are full.
Finish with yogurt, a scatter of granola, a halved strawberry and mint.
Chill for twenty minutes so the layers set into each other.
dishes.chef_note: Serve with a long spoon, so the eater can reach the bottom before reconsidering.
dishes.photo_prompt: Two tall clear parfait glasses with visible layers of pink strawberry yogurt, pale cubes of gefilte fish and bright yellow corn kernels, topped with granola, a halved strawberry and mint leaf, on a marble countertop, soft daylight, side angle

dishes.name: Confetti Tuna Celebration Cake
recipe: 6 slices white sandwich bread, crusts off
steps: Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, celery and lemon into a smooth salad.
Stack the bread three layers high, two stacks side by side, with tuna salad between each layer.
Press gently and chill for ten minutes to firm up.
Frost the whole cake with cream cheese, smoothing the sides with a palette knife.
Press rainbow sprinkles all over the top and sides, and add a candle.
dishes.chef_note: A Scandinavian smörgåstårta, mistranslated with great confidence.
dishes.photo_prompt: A small rectangular sandwich cake frosted with white cream cheese and covered in rainbow sprinkles, one slice cut away to reveal layers of white bread and tuna salad, a single birthday candle on top, on a cake stand, festive party table, bright light

dishes.name: Herring Fairy Bread
dishes.tagline: An Australian children's party, catered from a Lithuanian shtetl.
recipe: 1 jar herring in cream sauce, drained
steps: Butter each slice of bread right to the edges.
Spread a thin, even layer of Marmite over the butter.
Lay pieces of herring across the bread.
Shower generously with sprinkles until no Marmite shows through.
Cut into triangles and arrange on a party plate.
dishes.chef_note: For a grown-up version, serve with a shot of chilled vodka. For a children's version, don't.
dishes.photo_prompt: White bread triangles covered in colorful hundreds and thousands sprinkles with pieces of pickled herring in white cream sauce on top, a dark brown Marmite layer visible at the edges, arranged on a colorful children's party plate, balloons blurred in background

dishes.name: Ranch-Nutella Fondue
dishes.tagline: The salad bar has finally been invited to dessert.
recipe: Strawberries, marshmallows and pretzel rods, for dipping
steps: Warm the Nutella and chocolate syrup together in a small pot until glossy.
Off the heat, whisk in the ranch dressing; it will turn the color of milky cocoa.
Pour into a fondue pot over a low flame.
Arrange the strawberries, marshmallows, pretzels and celery around it on a board.
Dip, swirl, and avoid eye contact.
dishes.chef_note: The celery is the only thing on the board that understands what is happening.
dishes.photo_prompt: Fondue pot filled with glossy light brown chocolate sauce, a strawberry on a fork being dipped in, surrounded by a wooden board of strawberries, marshmallows, pretzel rods, and green celery sticks, a bottle of ranch dressing and a jar of hazelnut spread in the background, warm cozy lighting

dishes.name: Gherkin Ripple Gelato
dishes.tagline: Two scoops of summer, with a crunch you will remember.
recipe: 1 litre vanilla ice cream, slightly softened
3 tbsp gherkin brine, reduced with 2 tbsp sugar to a syrup
steps: Simmer the gherkin brine with sugar until syrupy, then cool completely.
Fold the chopped gherkins through the softened ice cream.
Swirl in the brine syrup in streaks; do not fully mix.
Freeze for two hours until firm.
Scoop into waffle cones and garnish each with a tiny gherkin and a frond of dill.
dishes.chef_note: Serve in July, outdoors, where the screaming carries less.
dishes.photo_prompt: Two scoops of creamy vanilla ice cream in a waffle cone, studded with bright green chopped pickle pieces and swirled with pale green syrup, a small whole gherkin and dill sprig on top, sunny summer outdoor background, shallow depth of field

dishes.name: Pickleback Peanut Butter Float
dishes.tagline: An American soda-fountain classic, with notes of deli.
steps: Whisk the peanut butter with the pickle brine until smooth and pourable.
Smear a ribbon of the mixture up the inside of a tall glass.
Fill the glass with ice.
Pour the cola slowly; it will foam in a tan cloud where it meets the peanut butter.
Garnish with the pickle spear and straw.
dishes.chef_note: Stir once, sip once, then decide what kind of person you are.
dishes.photo_prompt: Tall soda fountain glass of foaming cola with ice, a streak of peanut butter on the inside of the glass, a whole dill pickle spear standing in it, a striped red and white paper straw, retro diner counter background, chrome and neon, vibrant
